cost.full_cost_field_rule: full_cost is always the exact not_measured_v1 one-attempt metadata object with all eight secondary quantities null, preprocessing included, none_single_target, target count 1, reusable_setup=false, shared_setup_id=null; when reached equal_success_full_cost equals full_cost byte-for-byte, and when unreachable equal_success_full_cost is null

estimation.cluster_count_formula: B = S + F + C over distinct (curve_fixture_id, algorithm_seed) clusters after repetition agreement
estimation.deterministic_verified_success_rule: For bsgs_v1, all authenticated seed clusters and repetitions for a target must have identical status, failure, and semantic counters; S=B>=1 and F=C=0 gives empirical_probability=conservative_probability=1 and r_emp=r_cons=K_emp=K_cons=1 for both targets; no_solution or mixed deterministic outcomes abort analysis; all resource-censored clusters are unreachable and never geometric retries

output_mapping.median_online_group_operations_decimal: quantize_12(the arithmetic median of online_target.group_law_invocations over uncensored clusters), or null when no uncensored cluster exists
output_mapping.normalized_expected_group_operations_dec: the same value as conservative_normalized_group_operations_decimal when reached, otherwise null
output_mapping.offline_group_operations: maximum offline_setup.group_law_invocations over all authenticated clusters in the partition
output_mapping.estimated_algorithmic_memory_bytes: maximum estimated_algorithmic_table_bytes over all authenticated clusters in the partition
output_mapping.restart_max: maximum counters.restarts over all authenticated clusters in the partition
output_mapping.restart_total: sum counters.restarts over all authenticated clusters in the partition

estimation.unreachable_output_rule: equal_success_attempts, expected_attempts_decimal, both normalized costs, and equal_success_full_cost are null

inference.candidate_validity: full_rank under decimal_gaussian_elimination_v1 and n > k + 1
inference.leave_one_size_out_coverage: one row for every authenticated usable field_bits rung exactly once; omitted_field_bits is the rung and omitted_subgroup_orders is the sorted exact set of orders removed with that rung
inference.model_uncertainty_representation: clustered uncertainty is reported only on each method-target comparison; model_fits use candidate_model_evidence plus exact leave_one_size_out rows and have no second ambiguous scalar uncertainty field
inference.narrow_order_range_warning_rule: emit narrow_order_range when max(exact_log2_subgroup_order)-min(exact_log2_subgroup_order) < 4; exact boundary 4 does not warn
inference.numeric_algorithm: Sort observations by (field_bits,subgroup_order,curve_fixture_id,algorithm_seed with null before integers). Build Decimal precision-80 design X and y. Determine rank by row-reducing X with maximum-absolute pivot and lowest-row tie break. Build A=X^T*X and b=X^T*y in that order and solve A*theta=b by the same elimination. In each calculation the fixed tolerance is 1e-60*max(1,maximum absolute entry of the original matrix being reduced).
inference.residual_formula_exact: Compute predictions and residuals at Decimal precision 80 from unquantized x,y,theta; RSS=sum(residual_i^2) at precision 80; max(RSS,1e-24) applies only inside ln; quantize only serialized coefficients, RSS, AICc, delta, prediction, observation, and residual fields
inference.selection_tie_rule: compare unquantized precision-80 AICc; delta < 2 is undecided with model_unstable; delta >= 2 selects the smaller AICc; exact boundary 2 selects
inference.usable_observation_policy: uncensored_and_reached_only. For rho, one unweighted observation per authenticated target-seed cluster. For BSGS, one unweighted observation per authenticated target after deterministic-replicate agreement; seeds never duplicate BSGS fit rows. x=log2(subgroup_order), y=log2(conservative_equal_success_group_operations). n is the resulting observation count.

uncertainty.delete_one_rule: recompute S,F,C,probabilities,r,K and the statistic for the full sample and every one of B distinct-cluster deletions
uncertainty.numeric_bounds_rule: lower and upper exist only when the full estimate and all B delete-one estimates are reachable; otherwise uncertainty status is unavailable and both bounds are null
uncertainty.unreachable_delete_one_action: The comparison full-sample status and costs remain determined only by the full sample. Emit unreachable_success_target, set unreachable_delete_one_count exactly, set clustered_uncertainty status=unavailable with null bounds, exclude this comparison from model inputs, and select model_undecided_v1.

sensitivity.bsgs_rule: If every cluster is a deterministic verified success, probability=1, r=K=1 and reached; if any BSGS cluster is censored, sensitivity is unreachable with attempts and cost null; mixed or impossible outcomes abort analysis
sensitivity.expected_attempts_formula: Apply the same Decimal precision-80 repeat-requirement r function to the sensitivity probability and quantize r to 12 places only for serialization
sensitivity.normalized_cost_formula: K_sensitivity * the same arithmetic mean of uncensored total group-law invocations used by the primary estimate; censored partial counters remain excluded
sensitivity.reached_condition: probability > 0 and K_sensitivity <= B; otherwise attempts and normalized cost are null

warning_triggers.model_unstable: delta_AICc < 2 or any required delete-one-size selection differs or is invalid
warning_triggers.unreachable_success_target: full estimate or any required delete-one-cluster estimate is unreachable
